runtimeEscalation.reason: Only an authorized Unity materialization can prove generated Prefab, Fixture Scene and GPU evidence.

caseAssertions.normal-input: A valid ScreenSpec v3 is normalized against the registered component catalog.
caseAssertions.invalid-input: Malformed schema, unknown components and invalid bindings are rejected.
caseAssertions.denied-expansion: Unregistered component, path, asset or output expansion is denied.
caseAssertions.repeat-idempotency: The same normalized ScreenSpec produces the same materialization plan hash.
caseAssertions.hash-change-cache-invalidation: Changed schema, registry or Skill resources invalidate stale output claims.
caseAssertions.interruption-recovery: Interrupted materialization remains incomplete until a fresh receipt is produced.
caseAssertions.deterministic-output: Ordered components and bounded artifact declarations are deterministic.

responsibilityScope: Static acceptance of ScreenSpec v3 normalization and bounded UI materialization planning; it does not prove Unity or GPU behavior.

specializedAcceptance.title: ScreenSpec v3 static materialization planning
specializedAcceptance.runtimeBoundary: Static checks do not prove Unity Prefab output, Fixture Scene generation, GPU screenshots or visual fidelity.
